Title: Customer can update their details with valid contact information
Step Action: Open the Edit Customer/Invoice details page for the signed-in customer.
Step Expected: The page heading is Edit Customer/Invoice details and the customer and invoice form fields are visible.

Step Action: Fill the required customer fields with valid values for contact name, organisation, address, telephone and email.
Step Expected: The entered values match the expected values and no validation warning is shown for the required customer fields.

Step Action: Fill the required invoice details with valid values for organisation, address and email.
Step Expected: The invoice section accepts the values and shows no validation warning for the required invoice fields.

Step Action: Submit the updated details by selecting UPDATE DETAILS.
Step Expected: The page submits without a client-side validation error and the update request is sent.
The customer detail update is confirmed and the user can continue without being blocked by validation errors.

Title: Customer is blocked from saving when required contact details are empty
Step Action: Open the Edit Customer/Invoice details page for the signed-in customer.
Step Expected: The form is loaded and the required field controls are visible.

Step Action: Clear the Contact Name, Organisation name, Address line 1, Address line 2, Telephone and Email fields.
Step Expected: The fields are empty and the form is ready to validate.

Step Action: Attempt to update the customer details.
Step Expected: The page stops the save and shows the required-field validation messages for the empty customer data.

Step Action: Check the form state after the validation failure.
Step Expected: The required fields remain highlighted and the update is not persisted.

Step Action: Change the Contact Name field to a value and resubmit.
Step Expected: The validation error clears only for the Contact Name field and the remaining required fields remain enforced.

Title: Customer cannot submit an order until terms and required consent declarations are accepted
Step Expected: The Create New Order page opens.

Step Action: Tick the last scheme that has a month available to order.
Step Expected: The scheme is ticked and its months are ticked.
The Pending Order summary is shown.

Step Action: Leave the terms and conditions unticked.
